title: FATES-SLICE-003A — Constrained host route completion and process-origin proof
objective: Implement the smallest Moirae constrained-host boundary and prepare a bounded process-origin proof for Moirae -> Horae -> canonical Ananke -> Horae -> Moirae using the already sealed Slice 02 action, with one harmless producer-owned read and typed, fail-closed evidence.

repositoriesInvolved.role: Primary owner of the narrow host/origin boundary, Horae-only initiation, and typed result presentation.

repositoriesInvolved.name: horae
repositoriesInvolved.role: Existing sealed Slice 02 handoff, fresh Ananke checks, canonical dispatch, and typed relay consumer; no change unless a genuine blocker is found.

repositoriesInvolved.name: ananke
repositoriesInvolved.role: Existing sealed Slice 02 action authority, producer/effect owner, and sole physical fixed-fixture reader; no change unless a genuine blocker is found.

repositoriesInvolved.name: fates-integration
repositoriesInvolved.role: Control-state, traceability, validation, and later cross-runtime evidence owner.

requiredConsumerTests: Moirae: fixed action and fixed route construction, process-origin binding, Horae-only transport, typed result receipt, timeout handling, malformed/origin/drift rejection, and no direct Ananke or alternate-path fallback.
Horae: fresh expected-origin, identity, endpoint, readiness, producer, capability, and canonical dispatch checks remain green against the sealed Slice 02 route.
Ananke: the sealed fixed action remains the authority and sole physical reader with one-read and digest evidence; no producer implementation change is authorized.
Runtime Contracts and Mnemosyne: remain unchanged and outside the 003A route.
integrationTests: One eventual real three-process positive route with an independently started Moirae process, when explicitly scheduled after owner review.
Process-origin evidence is bound to the request and preserved through Horae and Ananke evidence.
The request reaches Horae first and Horae reaches only the canonical Ananke endpoint; no direct, alternate, fallback, fixture, retry, or duplicate path is accepted.
Fresh Horae checks, exact producer/capability identity, one harmless producer-owned read, typed result state, route/event/request/correlation preservation, and clean stop are evidenced.

Malformed input, origin drift, Horae drift, Ananke denial, timeout, indeterminate outcome, retry, and duplicate-dispatch cases fail closed in deterministic tests; live fault induction remains a later decision.
deferredWork: FATES-SLICE-003B or later: OS/filesystem/network/shell/subprocess/browser/extension containment and broader host bypass resistance.
Credential custody, credential brokerage, environment isolation, and secret-boundary work.
Generic governed actions, arbitrary filesystem access, alternate MCP transports, direct Ananke access, retry, persistence, idempotency, reconciliation, and recovery.
Qualified Mnemosyne context retrieval or any memory authority claim.
Future live fault induction for timeout, post-dispatch indeterminate loss, and wrong producer/capability remains separately scoped; deterministic coverage is retained here.
stopConditions: Stop on any required Runtime Contracts change, sealed Horae or Ananke behavior change, contract mismatch, or need to modify a sealed producer/consumer checkpoint.
Stop if the host needs OS sandboxing, credential handling, UI/extension mediation, direct Ananke access, an alternate MCP endpoint, retry, fallback, persistence, or any bypass of the canonical route.
Do not modify fates-lock.json, compatibility-matrix.json, the Slice 02 compatibility snapshot, Slice 02 evidence, tags, or seal claims during 003A preparation.
After Moirae, Horae, Ananke, and Integration owner-local validation is green, stop for review before formal live acceptance.

finalEvidence.acceptance: FORMALLY ACCEPTED AND SEALED on 2026-08-10 as FATES-SLICE-003A. The successful live evidence is docs/evidence/FATES-SLICE-003A-live-acceptance-2026-08-10.json. The sealed compatibility set is fates-slice-003a-2026-08-10; Moirae is pinned to f9b28fb0099d5d32d5debd4db7376066bfc2ac93 with annotated tag moirae-fates-slice-003a-v0.1.0-protocol-1.4.0, while Ananke and Horae remain at their sealed Slice 02 checkpoints. Integration validation, owner-local checks, and required remote CI passed. The active-slice slot is idle. This seal does not start 003B.
limitations: The historical locked Moirae compatibility reference a4783db271a61848c66ac4f6652a539bdb515e28 and design lineage bc48c25a1a5f793d69f38b3a7a2c05e50c9427d6 remain recorded as prior checkpoints; the new f9b28fb0099d5d32d5debd4db7376066bfc2ac93 implementation checkpoint is distinct and independently tagged.
The bounded host boundary proves process-origin and route intent only; it does not claim OS-wide containment, credential isolation, or complete local-machine bypass resistance.
Mnemosyne and Runtime Contracts are outside the route and unchanged.
Attempt 0 Defender interaction and Attempt 1 harness configuration failure remain preserved in the accepted chronology; neither is a Fates runtime failure or a confirmed false positive.

The sealed claim excludes OS filesystem/network/shell/subprocess, browser/extension, credential, arbitrary IPC, direct-Ananke operating-system prevention, alternate-MCP operating-system prevention, complete bypass resistance, and full-machine security.
003B, qualified Mnemosyne context retrieval, durable recovery/idempotency, and content preflight remain outside this seal.
